scope: Development contact-edit study across four action families; not held-out release evaluation or an action whitelist.
selection_policy: All four named development actions at seeds 11 and 22, without screening solver outcomes. Bind the lowest region material vertex at pin start; target its interval-midpoint source position plus the declared offset, with target Y at least 2 mm. Report timing conflicts without changing windows, targets, seeds or budgets. A stationary pin is an authored edit request, not proof of plausible support.
acceptance: Original checked 5 mm stationary-pin tolerance, source point/global rate ceilings and root/rotation budgets, no per-time added floor depth, held outside segments. Record independent body/support flags and engine import separately; passing contact limits is not quality approval.
